ideas.title: The Impact of the DOJ Investigation on the Economy
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential impact of the DOJ investigation into Fed Chair Powell on the economy.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the investigation on the economy?
How will the investigation affect the Federal Reserve's decision-making process?
ideas.insight: I believe that this investigation has the potential to destabilize the economy, and I would like to investigate the potential consequences.
